cohort: 51 patients with iSUA and 54 controls with normal umbilical arteries.
finding: Isolated single umbilical artery (iSUA) was associated with lower newborn weight and a higher rate of total adverse pregnancy outcomes.
birth_weight: Lower in the iSUA group (2898.82+/-434.56 g) compared to the control group (3143.70+/-419.09 g, p=0.004)
